raw_graphql_pull_request.body: [Model] DeepSeek V4.1: enable DSpark speculative decoding under pipeline parallelism Depends on #63617 (PP2 cannot complete KV allocation without it); the input_ids PP-contract gate for requires_raw_input_tokens is already on main (vllm/v1/worker/gpu/model_runner.py#L2009) - v0.31.0 predates it. Stock rejects DSpark + PP for DeepSeek V4.1 at load time (the eagle3_utils verify reads supports_aux_hidden_states_over_pp on the inner decoder). This enables it with a model-only change: - supports_aux_hidden_states_over_pp = True on DeepseekV4Model, plus the partition-independent relay: pack_local_aux_hidden_states into the non-last-stage IntermediateTensors and collect_remote_aux_hidden_states before the local aux list on the last stage. The slot math (_aux_slot_base_cached, bisect_right in _set_aux_hidden_state_layers) already lives in EagleModelMixin; V4.1 inherits it, and reserve_aux_intermediate_tensor_slots reserves (batch, hidden) slots matching V4.1's aux shape (previous_post.mean(dim=1) -> [T, hidden], model.py:579), so the relay needs no further model plumbing. - dspark.py: PP-conditional has_own_embed_tokens (the target's embed_tokens is a PPMissingLayer on the last stage, so mainline's maybe_share_target_embed must skip the share), the draft's own embed.weight load (~1.3 GB on the last stage) with a post-load assert so a renamed checkpoint key fails loudly, and the docstring updated where it said the draft always aliases the target's. Verification honesty: the relay path (an aux layer upstream of the last stage) cannot be exercised on our hardware - any split putting layer 37 on rank 0 means 38 layers on one GB300, which does not fit. The pack/collect is verified by the default 20/20 split plus code read; maintainers with larger PP setups are asked for a run. Receipts (2x DGX Station GB300, 400G CX8 RoCE, image vllm-openai:v0.31.0 with these changes as source overlays, identical temp-0 prompt, deterministic x3): - All-reduces per decode step: 84 -> 0. One profiled window (3 generations, 879 tokens, ~237 steps at ~3.7 accepted/step): 0 AllReduce, 0 AllGather kernels; ~2 SendRecv + ~3 Broadcast per step (pipeline hops and draft-token distribution). - Single-stream: 290.5 -> 391 tok/s (+34%). - Step time 12.3 ms -> ~9.4 ms (derived: tok/s / accepted length, not a direct measurement). - GSM8K: 97/100, 0 errors (temp 0, first 100 of openai/gsm8k test/main, 0-shot). - Free KV cache 72.7 / 57.1 GiB per rank (~2x the TP2 pool); vision verified end-to-end (image tokens route through bias_vl on both stages; correct answers, deterministic). - Concurrency curve on this build: C1 323 / C2 406 / C4 595 / C8 974 aggregate tok/s - the pipeline needs admission depth to fill both stages, and TP2-vs-PP2 at C4-C16 is unmeasured here. Temp-0 outputs differ from TP2 (0/24 md5s) - documented divergence: TP2 sums bf16 GEMM partials across GPUs; PP2 computes each GEMM whole. Deterministic within a parallel shape. Full recipe, overlays as .diffs, verification instruments: https://github.com/ebfio/deepseek-v41-flash-pp2-pair --- Need help on this PR? nodes.body:
TP2 vs PP2 at concurrency, measured after filing (identical soak script and 24-prompt corpus, fresh boot per side, temp 0.7, zero swap on both):

| C | TP2 aggregate (tok/s) | PP2 aggregate (tok/s) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 234.2 | 323.4 |
| 2 | 326.2 | 405.7 |
| 4 | 422.9 | 594.9 |
| 8 | 547.7 | 974.4 |
| 16 | 842.5 | 1266.4 |

PP2 dominates at every measured concurrency. Mechanism: TP2's compute step is batch-insensitive, but its collective step is not — the per-step all-reduce payload grows linearly with batch tokens, and 84 calls per step stretch from ~3 ms at C1 toward ~16 ms at C16 on this fabric (per-call latency 37 → 67 → 187 µs at 61 KiB → 490 KiB → 1 MiB, from the NCCL bracket on the same fabric), so TP2's aggregate saturates at ~3.6× C1 while PP2's two p2p hops stay microseconds of bandwidth and the pipeline keeps filling with admission depth.

The single-stream +34% in the description is therefore the floor of this enablement's value, not the ceiling.

Both curves and the measurement method are in the repo: https://github.com/ebfio/deepseek-v41-flash-pp2-pair

 import vllm.envs as envs
 from vllm.config import VllmConfig, get_current_vllm_config
 from vllm.config.kernel import NATIVE_MEGA_MOE_BACKENDS
+from vllm.distributed import get_pp_group
 from vllm.forward_context import get_forward_context, is_forward_context_available
 from vllm.logger import init_logger
 from vllm.model_executor.kernels.mhc.tilelang import (
@@ -275,7 +276,9 @@ def _insert_context_kv(
 
 class DSparkDeepseekV4ForCausalLM(nn.Module):
     # Draft weights ship in the target checkpoint (mtp.*) without embed/head, so
-    # load_dspark_model always aliases the target's.
+    # TP builds alias the target's embedding (load_dspark_model). Under PP
+    # the target's embed_tokens is a PPMissingLayer on the last stage, so the
+    # draft loads its own copy (see load_weights).
     has_own_embed_tokens = False
     has_own_lm_head = False
     # Full-vocab draft: draft ids are target ids, no remapping needed.
@@ -287,6 +290,10 @@ def __init__(self, *, vllm_config: VllmConfig, prefix: str = "") -> None:
         self.draft_model_config = vllm_config.speculative_config.draft_model_config
         self.config = self.draft_model_config.hf_config
         self.quant_config = vllm_config.quant_config
+        # PP>1: the target's embed_tokens is a PPMissingLayer on the last
+        # stage, so the draft must load its own copy. Gates
+        # maybe_share_target_embed's share path.
+        self.has_own_embed_tokens = get_pp_group().world_size > 1
         self.linear_scale_name = _linear_scale_param_name(
             vllm_config, getattr(self.config, "expert_dtype", "fp4")
         )
@@ -406,6 +413,13 @@ def load_weights(self, weights: Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]) -> set[str]:
         loaded_confidence_head = False
 
         for name, loaded_weight in weights:
+            if name == "embed.weight" and self.has_own_embed_tokens:
+                # PP>1: load the draft's own embedding from the checkpoint;
+                # the target's lives on the first stage.
+                param = params_dict["model.embed_tokens.weight"]
+                param.weight_loader(param, loaded_weight)
+                loaded_params.add("model.embed_tokens.weight")
+                continue
             mapped = self._remap_dspark_name(name)
             if mapped is None:
                 continue
@@ -485,6 +499,13 @@ def load_weights(self, weights: Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]) -> set[str]:
         if self.model.confidence_head is not None and not loaded_confidence_head:
             self.model.confidence_head = None
         logger.info_once("DSpark draft model loaded: %d params", len(loaded_params))
+        if self.has_own_embed_tokens:
+            # A renamed checkpoint key must fail loudly here, not produce a
+            # draft with an unloaded embedding table.
+            assert "model.embed_tokens.weight" in loaded_params, (
+                "PP>1: the draft must load its own embed.weight, but the "
+                "checkpoint never yielded it"
+            )
         return loaded_params
 
     def _remap_dspark_name(self, name: str) -> str | None:

@@ -697,6 +697,11 @@ def write_kv(
 
 
 class DeepseekV4Model(nn.Module, EagleModelMixin):
+    # DSpark's draft consumes aux hidden states from layers that may sit on
+    # an upstream PP stage; the Eagle3 relay (pack/collect below) carries
+    # them across the boundary, so aux states are supported under PP.
+    supports_aux_hidden_states_over_pp = True
+
     def __init__(self, *, vllm_config: VllmConfig, prefix: str = ""):
         super().__init__()
 
@@ -1114,15 +1119,23 @@ def forward(
                 full_num_tokens,
             )
 
-        aux_hidden_states = [
-            aux_hidden_by_layer[layer_id]
-            for layer_id in self.aux_hidden_state_layers
-            if layer_id in aux_hidden_by_layer
-        ] + late_aux
+        aux_hidden_states = (
+            self.collect_remote_aux_hidden_states(intermediate_tensors)
+            + [
+                aux_hidden_by_layer[layer_id]
+                for layer_id in self.aux_hidden_state_layers
+                if layer_id in aux_hidden_by_layer
+            ]
+            + late_aux
+        )
 
         if not get_pp_group().is_last_rank:
             return IntermediateTensors(
-                {"hidden_states": hidden_states, "pre_mix": pre_mix}
+                {
+                    "hidden_states": hidden_states,
+                    "pre_mix": pre_mix,
+                    **self.pack_local_aux_hidden_states(aux_hidden_states),
+                }
             )
 
         # MTP needs full HC states; otherwise collapse and normalize locally
